subject.title: Lowell Joint School District Board, Trustee Area 4

text: As a proud member of the Lowell Joint School District Board of Trustees since 2018, it has been a privilege to serve our students, families, educators, and community. As a former teacher, mother of Lowell graduates, and grandmother of students in our district, I bring both professional experience and a lifelong commitment to public education.

During my tenure, I have helped oversee the successful implementation of Measures LL and P, ensuring these voter-approved investments provide safe, modern, and engaging learning environments for our students.

My priorities remain clear: maintaining fiscal responsibility, attracting and retaining outstanding teachers and staff, supporting student achievement and well-being, and ensuring every school is a safe, inclusive, and inspiring place to learn. I am committed to transparent leadership, open communication, and strong partnerships with parents, educators, students, and our community.

Lowell Joint has a proud tradition of excellence. I respectfully ask for your vote so I may continue serving our community with integrity, accessibility, and an unwavering commitment to every student's success.

statement.disclaimer: Statements are volunteered by the candidates and have not been checked for accuracy by any official agency.
